name: Draft Replies
description: Drafts replies to email (instant) and LinkedIn (scheduled sweep) in your voice into Draft Desk — you approve, nothing sends without you
author: flock

routines.name: Watch my inbox
routines.prompt: New mail arrived. Review what needs a reply and draft responses in Draft Desk in my voice for my approval. Skip anything automated or already queued. Never send.

routines.name: LinkedIn draft sweep
routines.prompt: Check LinkedIn messages and comments that need a reply. For each one that genuinely needs a response, draft a reply in Draft Desk in my voice for my approval. Skip anything already queued. Never send.
